en: Black‑and‑white view of a wooded river valley with a calm stream in the foreground and two large historic buildings on a forested hillside in the background. The buildings have steep, gabled roofs and multiple small windows, resembling an old European castle or manor complex. Leafy branches frame the top edge of the image. There is no clear printed caption on the front, only some faint handwritten or scratched marks near the lower border.
